skill.zifeng_s_custom_skill_tree.machine: Machine Founder
Loot Big Bang Resonance
Unbreaking Resonance
Looting Resonance
Fortune Resonance
XP Boost Resonance
Spawn Egg Resonance
Mob Head Resonance
Auto Smelter Resonance
Zone Place

Zone Place: one-time unlock (50 SP)
Hold a block item as a label and press the trigger key
to fill the selected zone with that block
Material order: bound container first, then held item,
skipping spots if none remain
(The held item is only a label; real materials
come from the bound container first)
Stick Tool ZONE-P place mode: left-click two corners to select
Zone Excavate

Zone Excavate: one-time unlock (50 SP)
Hold any tool as a label and press the trigger key
to instantly excavate the whole selected zone
(no progress bar, no particles, no XP)
Water and lava (incl. flowing) are cleared too
End portal frames/barriers/command blocks stay unbreakable
The tool only provides enchantments (Silk Touch/Fortune,
no durability loss)
Drops go into the bound container first;
extras are removed automatically
Linked boosts (learn & enable the skills):
Auto-Smelt -> drops are smelted first (ores become ingots)
Block-Drop -> ore drops x multiplier (non-Fortune blocks stay)
Stick Tool ZONE-E excavate mode: left-click two corners to select
Zone Attack

Zone Attack: one-time unlock (50 SP)
When enabled, automatically attacks mobs in the
selected zone
Damage/attack interval/enchantments/chaos damage
are exactly the same as the Aura of Slaughter,
only the circular radius becomes the selected zone
Stick Tool ZONE-A attack mode: left-click two corners to select
Zone Protect

Zone Protect: one-time unlock (50 SP)
When enabled you can mark up to 10 protected zones
(each side max 64 blocks)
Creatures inside are skipped by ANY player's Aura of
Slaughter and Zone Attack - only blocks aura damage
(including area judgement and void-kill direct channels;
monster/environmental/normal melee damage is NOT blocked)
Stick Tool ZONE-D protect mode: left-click two corners
to add a zone; sneak + left-click a gold box to remove it
(clicking after the 10th zone does nothing)
